name: Peet's Coffee Steamed Oat Milk Vanilla Steamer (Caffeine-Free)
whyItWorks: Creamy Pacific Barista oat milk gently steamed with a single pump of pure vanilla syrup. Zero caffeine, zero dairy, zero acids; wonderfully comforting on inflamed mucosa.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Steamed Oat Milk with 1 pump of vanilla syrup—NO espresso, NO dairy.'
